body:
Fix sidecar UI integration by conforming sidecar.json manifest to Jetski UI plugin specifications and updating jetski-launcher and server.mjs for standalone and host-embedded execution.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. .agents/sidecars/agb-dashboard/sidecar.json must specify valid ui_config with leading '/' paths, entrypoint, title, display_name, and relative command invocation.
2. sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs must resolve repository root directory relative to the sidecar folder when called with relative args (e.g. '../../../').
3. sidecars/server.mjs must serve HTML UI, CSS, JS, and event logs reliably under both standalone port mode and Jetski host-embedded mode.
4. npm test passes 100% cleanly with zero regressions.
title: Fix sidecar UI plugin integration for Antigravity/Jetski dashboard
